# Overview & Syllabus Context

According to the [PHY C54 Syllabus](syllabus.qmd), Continuum Mechanics is the capstone topic of the course in **Week 12** (Taylor Ch 16: 1–4).

## Core Topics
1. **Transverse Motion of a Taut String:** Continuous limit of a 1D lattice of coupled oscillators.
2. **The 1D Classical Wave Equation:**
   $$ \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial t^2} = c^2 \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}, \quad c = \sqrt{\frac{T}{\mu}} $$
3. **Lagrangian Density ($\mathcal{L}_{\text{density}}$):** Transition from discrete generalized coordinates $q_i(t)$ to continuous field configurations $\phi(x, t)$:
   $$ S = \int dt \int dx \, \mathcal{L}\left(\phi, \frac{\partial \phi}{\partial x}, \frac{\partial \phi}{\partial t}, x, t\right) $$
4. **Euler-Lagrange Field Equations:**
   $$ \frac{\partial \mathcal{L}}{\partial \phi} - \frac{\partial}{\partial x}\left( \frac{\partial \mathcal{L}}{\partial (\partial \phi / \partial x)} \right) - \frac{\partial}{\partial t}\left( \frac{\partial \mathcal{L}}{\partial (\partial \phi / \partial t)} \right) = 0 $$
5. **Bridge to Classical Field Theory:** Stress-energy-momentum conservation in continuum mechanics and the foundations of modern theoretical physics.

*(Detailed analytical lecture derivations and worked examples will be added here during Week 12).*
